label: AI & Model Risk Assessment
description: First-class AI and model-risk assessment for financial-crime and credit models: builds a model inventory, then assesses transaction-monitoring drift, sanctions-screening match calibration, credit-scoring fairness, and GenAI/synthetic-identity fraud models across the full model lifecycle. Grounded in the EU AI Act, EBA model-governance expectations, DORA ICT-risk, and the SR 11-7 / TRIM lineage.

guidedInputs.label: Known Issues or Concerns
guidedInputs.description: Describe any known model issues: drift, validation backlog, vendor opacity, bias findings, alert-quality complaints, audit or supervisory observations.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. TM scenarios last tuned 2023; SAR conversion rate fell to 1.2%; sanctions screening fuzzy-match threshold never benchmarked; credit model is a vendor black box with no validation report; no documented human-override log for declined applications...

exampleInput: We are a Nordic consumer-lending fintech (~80 staff, SE/FI/DK lending licence) running three model families that nobody has formally inventoried as 'models': an AI credit-scoring model from a third-party vendor that drives auto-decline decisions, an in-house transaction-monitoring engine with ~40 rules plus a gradient-boosted alert-scoring overlay, and an OFAC/EU sanctions-screening tool with fuzzy name matching. Build a model inventory with owners and materiality tiers, then assess model risk across the lifecycle. We are most worried about three things: the credit model is a high-risk AI Act system but we have no validation report from the vendor and no fairness/bias testing across protected groups; the TM overlay has drifted — SAR conversion fell from 4% to 1.2% over a year and the scenarios were last tuned in 2023; and the sanctions tool's fuzzy-match threshold was set by the vendor at install and never benchmarked, so we don't know our false-negative exposure. There is no independent validation function, no model KRIs, and the only human oversight is a caseworker who 'usually' reviews declines.

exampleValues.known_concerns: Credit model is a vendor black box, high-risk under AI Act Annex III, no validation report or bias testing across protected groups. TM alert-scoring overlay has drifted — SAR conversion 4% to 1.2% in a year, scenarios last tuned 2023. Sanctions fuzzy-match threshold set by vendor at install and never benchmarked; false-negative exposure unknown. No independent validation function and no model KRIs.
